ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
There are $4$ mirrors facing the inside of a $5\times 7$ rectangle as shown in the figure. A ray of light comes into the inside of a rectangle through $A$ with an angle of $45^o$. When it hits the sides of the rectangle, it bounces off at the same angle, as shown in the diagram. How many times will the ray of light bounce before it reaches any one of the corners $A$, $B$, $C$, $D$? A bounce is a time when the ray hit a mirror and reflects off it.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a gridded rectangle, with the four corners labeled A, B, C, D, where A is at the upper-left corner, B is at the upper-right corner, C is at the lower-right corner, and D is at the lower-left corner. The dashed light ray enters from A, proceeds down to the right at a 45° angle, and after hitting the bottom side reflects at the same angle. Reasoning: Use the unfolding method to handle reflection: each time the ray hits a mirror and reflects, it can equivalently be regarded as the ray continuing in a straight line into a copy of the rectangle flipped across that side. Since the ray is 45°, in the unfolded diagram every time it moves 1 unit horizontally it also moves 1 unit vertically. When it reaches a corner point, the horizontal displacement must be a multiple of 7 and the vertical displacement must be a multiple of 5. The first time both are satisfied is lcm(7,5)=35, so in the unfolded diagram the ray reaches the corner point with horizontal displacement 35 and vertical displacement 35. Before reaching this final corner point, the ray crosses the vertical mirror lines x=7,14,21,28, a total of 4 times; it also crosses the horizontal mirror lines y=5,10,15,20,25,30, a total of 6 times. These numbers of crossings of mirror lines are the numbers of reflections. Finally it reaches the corner point at x=35, y=35 simultaneously, which does not count as a reflection. Therefore the total number of reflections is 4+6=10.

method.method_draft: Use an unfolding/reflected-rectangle model. First read the image: A is the top-left corner, B top-right, C bottom-right, D bottom-left; the rectangle is 7 grid units wide and 5 grid units tall, and the ray enters from A at 45 degrees downward to the right. From the text, all four sides are mirrors and a bounce is counted only when the ray hits a side and reflects before reaching a corner. Replace each reflection by letting the ray continue straight into a reflected copy of the rectangle. In this unfolded grid, the 45-degree ray moves 1 unit horizontally for every 1 unit vertically. It reaches a corner of some copy when its horizontal displacement is a multiple of 7 and its vertical displacement is a multiple of 5. The first such positive displacement is lcm(7,5)=35. Before that final corner, the ray crosses vertical mirror lines at 7,14,21,28 and horizontal mirror lines at 5,10,15,20,25,30, for a total of 4+6=10 bounces.
